name: ComfyUI
summary: An open-source, node-based program that allows users to generate images from text prompts using diffusion models.
description:
An open-source, node-based program that allows users to generate images from text prompts using diffusion models.

The most powerful and modular diffusion model GUI, api and backend with a graph/nodes interface. The fastest local inference engine in the world. - Comfy-Org/ComfyUI

Node-based workflow: Build custom image generation pipelines. Custom model support: Use your own or community models. Real-time preview: Instantly see prompt results. Workflow export: Share and reuse generation setups.

howToUse.title: Install ComfyUI
howToUse.description: Clone the repository from GitHub and follow the installation instructions for your OS.

howToUse.title: Launch the Interface
howToUse.description: Start the UI by running the provided script (e.g., python main.py).

howToUse.title: Build Your Workflow
howToUse.description: Drag and connect nodes to set up your image generation pipeline.

howToUse.title: Generate Images
howToUse.description: Enter text prompts, select models, and tweak settings. Preview results in real time.

howToUse.description: Export workflows or results for reuse or sharing with the community.
